name: CE_JE_MAPPINGS
description: CE_JE_MAPPINGS contains the journal entry mappings information for a given bank account. Each row in this table indicates a mapping between a combination of the bank account number, transaction code, and search string to a general ledger account. This table corresponds to the Journal Entry Mappings form.

columns.name: JE_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry mapping.

columns.name: RULE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the bank statement transaction creation rule.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the bank statement transaction creation rule.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the rule is active (yes) or inactive (no).

columns.name: TRX_CODE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the transaction code. Used as matching criteria.

columns.name: STMT_TRX_TYPE
columns.description: Transaction type of the bank statement line.

columns.name: SEARCH_FIELD
columns.description: Field that will be used to search the statement line.

columns.name: SEARCH_STRING_TXT
columns.description: Free form text that is used for matching statement lines in the search field.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Business unit associated with the rule.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the rule should be accounted or not.

columns.name: BANK_TRX_TYPE
columns.description: Transaction type of any bank statement transaction created from this rule.

columns.name: GL_CASH_CCID
columns.description: Mapped general ledger account code combination identifier.

columns.name: GL_OFFSET_CCID
columns.description: Mapped general ledger account code combination identifier.

columns.name: TRXN_SUBTYPE_CODE
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the legal entity identifier.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
